## Capability

Produce an artifact and a note on it.

## Outputs

### produced_path

Path of the produced artifact.

### undefaulted_note

Note on the produced artifact.

## Protocol

### 1. Produce Artifact

- Write the artifact; emit `{produced_path}` and `{undefaulted_note}`.
